kids: Hear school groups sing holiday songs
Watch Santa turn on the tree lights
site: Lake Concord Park, 95 Triplet Lake Dr
about: Casselberry's tree lighting is a city event, and the city calendar names it the annual tree lighting event for Saturday, December 5, 2026.
The program centers on singing. The city says various schools will perform, so many of the voices on stage belong to local students.
Santa Claus is the one who turns on the Christmas tree lights, and the tree stands behind City Hall at 95 Triplet Lake Drive.
A host of children's activities and vendors fill out the evening, and the city adds that free portrait style photos with Santa are possible if families use their own cameras.
Parking is available at adjacent businesses, which is useful because the ceremony takes place in Lake Concord Park behind City Hall rather than in front of the building.
Casselberry's next holiday night at the same park is Holiday Art & Music in the Park and Food Trucks on December 11, which also brings Santa for photos.
The city's own social post for the ceremony says the tree is lit at approximately 5:45 PM, which gives families time to find a spot on the lawn after the 5 PM start.
Lake Concord Park sits behind Casselberry City Hall, so the stage, the children's activities and the tree are all within a short walk of one another.
Casselberry keeps its holiday calendar on the city website, where the tree lighting entry carries the description annual tree lighting event and a map link to 95 Triplet Lake Drive.
faq: When is the Casselberry tree lighting in 2026?
Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 5 to 8 PM.
Where is the Casselberry tree lighting?
Lake Concord Park, behind City Hall, 95 Triplet Lake Drive, Casselberry, Florida 32707.
Is the tree lighting free?
Yes. The City of Casselberry lists the cost as free.
Who lights the tree?
The city says Santa Claus shows up to turn on the Christmas tree lights.
Are there activities for children?
Yes. The city lists a host of children's activities and vendors, plus school performances.
Can we take photos with Santa?
Yes. Families can take free portrait style photos with Santa using their own cameras.
Where do I park?
The city says parking is available at adjacent businesses.
What is the next Casselberry holiday event?
Holiday Art & Music in the Park and Food Trucks at Lake Concord Park on Friday, December 11, from 6 to 9 PM.
What time does Santa light the tree?
The city's social post for the ceremony gives approximately 5:45 PM, inside the 5 to 8 PM event window.
Is the tree lighting held inside City Hall?
No. It is an outdoor event in Lake Concord Park, and the tree stands behind City Hall.
Do I have to register for the ceremony?
No sign-up is needed. The city calendar lists the event as free with the time and the address.
What should we expect when we arrive at the ceremony?

Expect a free evening of student singing, children's activities and vendor tables, with Santa arriving to switch on the lights on the tree behind City Hall. Photos with Santa are free if you hold the camera yourself, and the lights come on around 5:45 PM according to the city's social post.
Who performs at the Casselberry tree lighting?
The city says various schools will be performing, so the program is made up of local student groups singing for the crowd.

kids: Get a photo with Santa Claus
Pick a bite from the food trucks
site: Lake Concord Park, 95 Triplet Lake Dr
about: Casselberry calls this one Holiday Art & Music in the Park and Berry Bazaar, a city run Friday night built around live music, food trucks and holiday vendors.
Doors are open to everyone from 6 to 9 PM on December 11, 2026, and nobody pays to get in.
Ten food trucks are on the schedule, so dinner can be a different truck for every family member.
Santa Claus is on hand for pictures while the bands play, which makes the park a handy place to cross a Santa visit off the list.
Vendors sell holiday goods, and the city pitches the night as a way to enjoy music and shopping two weeks before Christmas.
The Berry Bazaar graphic is the city's own branding for this vendor market, which sits in the same city park as the tree lighting held the Saturday before.

The city's Casselberry Food Trucks page describes the night as a Food Trucks and Berry Bazaar Holiday Market event on Friday, December 11, at Lake Concord Park, from 6 to 9 PM, and files it under the Art & Music in the Park series.
That series name explains the pairing of live music with food trucks, and the December edition adds the holiday vendors and Santa photos.
The city's vendor call for the Berry Bazaar went out as an open call for a holiday night market.
Visitors will see the 2026 Berry Bazaar graphic on the city's calendar listing, which carries the holiday night market branding that Casselberry also used when it called for vendors.
Because the entry is free, families only budget for what they buy: a food truck dinner, a handmade gift from a vendor, or both.
faq: What day and time is the Berry Bazaar night?
Friday, December 11, 2026, 6 to 9 PM.
What address do I use for directions?
95 Triplet Lake Drive, Casselberry, Florida 32707, the city's Lake Concord Park.
What does it cost to attend?
Nothing. The city calendar prints free as the cost.
Will Santa be there?
Yes, the city says Santa Claus is available for photos.
How many food trucks will there be?
The city counts 10.
Is there music?
Live music is the headline, backed by holiday vendors.
Who runs it?
The City of Casselberry, which posts it on its official calendar.
Is this the same night as the tree lighting?
No. The tree lighting is the Saturday before, December 5, and this is a separate Friday evening event.
What makes this different from the tree lighting a week earlier?

The tree lighting on December 5 is a ceremony with school choirs and Santa switching on the tree. The December 11 Berry Bazaar night is a market and music evening with ten food trucks, holiday vendors and a longer 6 to 9 PM window.
Can a family make a full evening of it?
Yes. Dinner comes from the food trucks, the entertainment is the live music, the shopping is the holiday vendors, and the Santa photo is available too, all in one park for no admission fee.
Is this part of a regular city series?

Yes. The city's Casselberry Food Trucks page lists it under Art & Music in the Park, the recurring food truck and music program, and the December edition is the holiday market version with the Berry Bazaar.
Are the sellers local?
The city issued an open call for vendors for its holiday night market, so the Berry Bazaar booths are the vendors the city accepted from that call.
How do the city's three pages describe the night?

The calendar entry calls it Holiday Art & Music in the Park and Berry Bazaar, the Casselberry Food Trucks page calls it a Food Trucks and Berry Bazaar Holiday Market, and both give Friday, December 11, 2026 at Lake Concord Park from 6 to 9 PM.
Does the city give a list of food trucks?
The city's calendar says 10 food trucks will serve the evening and gives no list of names, so the lineup is best checked on the city's Food Trucks page closer to the date.
Is it a good stop if we already saw Santa?
It can be, because the evening is mainly a market with live music and food trucks, and the Santa photos are an extra rather than the whole program.
